The interval length is \(81-60=21^\circ C\).  
For accuracy \(\pm 1^\circ C\), the final uncertainty interval must be at most \(2^\circ C\).

Using the fraction method, after \(n\) experiments the interval is reduced to \(\frac{21}{F_n}\). So
\[
\frac{21}{F_n}\le 2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad F_n\ge 10.5.
\]
With Fibonacci numbers \(F_0=F_1=1\), we have \(F_5=8,\ F_6=13\). Thus \(n=6\) experiments are needed.

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
